#if CRYPTO_ASYM_ENCRYPT_MODULE_ENABLED
psa_status_t tfm_crypto_asymmetric_encrypt_interface(psa_invec in_vec[],
                                                     psa_outvec out_vec[],
                                                     struct tfm_crypto_key_id_s *encoded_key)
{

arguments: Missing validation of IPC vector counts before asymmetric encrypt/decrypt vector indexing
message.text: Missing validation of IPC vector counts before asymmetric encrypt/decrypt vector indexing

properties.metisTriageReason: Verdict: the finding is valid because the asymmetric encrypt/decrypt interface dereferences in_vec[1], in_vec[2], and out_vec[0] without local vector-count validation, and the resolved dispatcher passes arrays onward without using in_len/out_len to enforce the required counts for this group. Evidence: crypto_asymmetric.c reads in_vec[0] then, for encrypt and decrypt cases, indexes in_vec[1], in_vec[2], and out_vec[0] at secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_asymmetric.c:109, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_asymmetric.c:117, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_asymmetric.c:119, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_asymmetric.c:121, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_asymmetric.c:136, secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_asymmetric.c:138, and secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_asymmetric.c:140; the dispatcher receives in_len/out_len at secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:196 but only checks in_vec[0].len at secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:209 before dispatching to this interface at secure_fw/partitions/crypto/crypto_init.c:247. Gap: none.
properties.mitigation: Add explicit per-operation validation of vector counts before accessing vector elements, preferably using dispatcher-supplied in_len/out_len. Fail closed with an error status if the call does not provide the required vectors.
properties.reasoning: The encrypt/decrypt interface assumes at least three input vectors and one output vector and indexes in_vec[0], in_vec[1], in_vec[2], and out_vec[0] without local bounds validation. In an IPC-facing crypto partition shim, vector counts are part of the trust boundary; if dispatch validation is absent, bypassed, or mismatched with this implementation, malformed calls could cause out-of-bounds reads of vector descriptors or use invalid base/length pairs in secure code. The reviewed source does not provide evidence that these preconditions are enforced here.
